target: doctor.sh forge section (gitlab) — a missing token is a [FAIL] naming the token
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_gh auth_status 0 "Logged in"
unset FORGE FORGE_URL FORGE_REMOTE FORGE_TOKEN GITLAB_TOKEN
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
fx_http "GET /api/v4/user" 200 '{"username":"x"}'
fx_doctor
fx_sec_has fail_lines '\[FAIL\]'
fx_sec_has mentions_token '\[FAIL\].*[Tt][Oo][Kk][Ee][Nn]'
echo "user_requests=$(fx_reqs | grep -c 'auth=present')"
fx_done
